title.narrative: HEALTH SYSTEM

description.narrative: An equitable, affordable, and resilient health system that leverages health information, engages communities, promotes multi- sectoral action and provides accessible and quality Primary Health Care (PHC) services including immunization and mental health services.

title.narrative: UNICEF Maldives supported health sector reforms, established an oxygen plant, and sustained high immunization levels. Mental health initiatives included helplines and Wellbeing Hangouts, reaching 5,916 adolescents with safe spaces to discuss mental health and break misconceptions.;Training for teachers and mental health professionals improved support for children and adolescents.
